title: Kenneth Walker III free agency: Seahawks unlikely to use franchise tag on Super Bowl MVP, per report

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: Sources: Seahawks unlikely to use tags on Walker
sources.description: The Seahawks are unlikely to use either a franchise or transition tag on running back and Super Bowl MVP Kenneth Walker III, league sources told ESPN.
